title: Backend rate-limit 429 lacks Retry-After header + opaque body
bug_summary: Agent diagnosis: express-rate-limit@8.3.2 already on standardHeaders:true (auto-emits Retry-After) so the "missing header" was env/proxy-version mismatch. Real gaps: opaque free-form body / non-standard retryAfter camelCase in chat-burst / no draft-7 combined RateLimit header for modern SDKs
fix_summary: All three limiters now standardHeaders:draft-7; custom handlers emit structured JSON {error:rate_limited retry_after limit window_seconds scope}; chatBurstRateLimiter preserves code:chat_burst_limit for back-compat. RateLimitInfo type augmentation. 3 new tests spinning real Express servers + HTTP clients verify the 429 contract. Live after: ratelimit: limit=30 remaining=0 reset=60 + retry-after: 60 + JSON body. 18/18 tests pass (15 existing + 3 new). Backlog -1009 (per-process limiter across pm2) explicitly out-of-scope
